translations.web: For the hurt of the daughter of my people, I am hurt. I mourn. Dismay has taken hold of me.
translations.bsb: For the brokenness of the daughter of my people I am crushed. I mourn; horror has gripped me.
translations.kjv: For the hurt of the daughter of my people am I hurt; I am black; astonishment hath taken hold
translations.asv: For the hurt of the daughter of my people am I hurt: I mourn; dismay hath taken hold on me.
